bounds.domain: One retained two-step legacy snapshot, a normalized row transaction, two reads, one rollback, and an eventual successful retry.
bounds.limitations: Abstracts payload bytes and SQL locking. Real PGlite tests preserve full prompts and step records across first open, rollback and retry. Progress assumes weakly fair migration and at most one failed attempt; no provider, crash or arbitrary database theorem.

assumptions: Weak fairness of migration progress; at most one rollback; successful normalized rows remain committed.
